agent.type: online empirical tabular 3-arm epsilon-greedy chosen-outcome bandit
agent.scope: decision among STOP/APPROVE/REJECT after scripted genuine public tool target discovery; target selection and tool-call planning are not learned
never_inputs: private original checklist or corrected scorer
agent.chosen_scalar: versioned v1 terminal reward minus 0.002 per actual source tool call
agent.reward_timing: only after original source finish and both separate restricted terminal checkers

training.task_rule_balance: 30/30 independently reset original source per mode
training.shuffled_definition: each episode except first is updated using a uniformly selected PRIOR actually chosen source outcome scalar, logged with its originating episode; no unchosen outcome or private oracle
training.true_definition: online update only actual chosen terminal v1 score
training.zero_definition: public identity/review status masked into one identical feature blind for both tasks; still actual chosen v1 terminal reward

prospective_evaluation.heldout_postcorrect_definition: evaluation-only public-rule legitimate first-stage correction performed on original untouched state, then frozen actor chooses a second action; new action context not observed during learning; not a different source family

nonclaims: No source-independent generalization or sealed test/dev family evaluation
No model-flop advantage inferred from source tool wall time
New corrected v1 reward engineered, not original source reward
Heldout postcorrect stage is not independent family transfer
